Constructor of the 0x4040-byte object allocated at 0073e030 and published in DAT_00f8bc4c, which is the localisation manager of docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md, not a GUI structure. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.
